title: Sensor readings API
name: sensors
prompt: A small HTTP API for my home sensors. Devices POST JSON readings {sensor, kind, value, at} using an API key, and I can GET the latest reading per sensor and the readings of one sensor over a time range. Also a minimal web page for me that shows the latest values in a table. Keep the data in Postgres.

answers: The devices will use API keys I create on the app's page. Read access for me only.

edits: Add GET /api/sensors/:id/daily that returns min, max and average per day for the last 30 days.
Delete readings older than one year automatically, once a day.
